style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 66cm Pre Lit Berry and Pinecone Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Deck the halls this festive season with this oversized frosted berry Christmas wreath. An extra large version of our best selling frosted berry wreath, this timeless statement piece features realistic faux pine, eucalyptus and artificial blue berries for an elegant and luxurious Christmas wreath that can be loved year after year. </p><p>At 66cm in diameter and pre lit with 50 warm white LEDs, your decoration is brought to life each evening with a comforting seasonal sparkle that encompasses the cosy feeling of Christmas. Perfect for styling inside on doors or as part of your Christmas dining display, it’s great for filling with our TruGlow® chapel candles for a mesmerising centrepiece. </p><p>To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6 hour timer function for an automatic glow at the same time each night. Size : ONE.</p>
